skill.description: Fetches TopHub hot list data and asks Claude to generate content topic ideas.
skill.summary: Turns current TopHub trends into concise content strategy suggestions.
skill.author: wangdefou-dev

security_audit.summary: Most command-execution and obfuscation detections are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, JavaScript template literals, Cheerio selector syntax, or Chinese text entropy. Real risks remain: the skill loads a parent .env file, handles an Anthropic API key, supports a configurable API base URL, fetches external TopHub content, writes local files, and sends untrusted web content into a Claude prompt.

remediation.suggestion: Avoid resolving outside the skill directory to load .env. Prefer runtime-provided environment variables or a clearly scoped skill-local config file.
Validate ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL against trusted Anthropic endpoints or remove the override for marketplace distribution.

remediation.issue: Untrusted trend data in model prompt
remediation.suggestion: Delimit fetched TopHub text as untrusted data and instruct Claude not to follow instructions contained inside trend titles or links.
Keep all generated files under a documented output directory and validate any future user-configurable output path.

semantic_findings.description: TopHub titles, sources, heat labels, and links are fetched from external HTML and inserted directly into the Claude user prompt. A malicious or compromised trend item could influence the generated report through prompt injection.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code formats scraped TopHub items into itemsText and embeds it in the model prompt without delimiting the data as untrusted. This creates a plausible indirect prompt injection path, although impact is limited to generated content.

content.value_statement: Content teams need fast signals from public hot lists before topics fade. This skill fetches TopHub trends and asks Claude to turn them into practical topic ideas.
actual_capabilities: Fetches the current TopHub hot list from the public TopHub website.
Parses ranks, titles, sources, heat labels, and links from hot list items.
Sends the top 30 trend items to Claude for content strategy analysis.
Generates Markdown topic suggestions with angles and traffic reasoning.
Saves raw trend data and generated analysis reports under an output directory.
limitations: Requires network access to TopHub and Anthropic services.
Requires an Anthropic API key unless mock mode is enabled.
Depends on the current TopHub page structure, which can change.
Generated topic advice needs human review before publication.

use_cases.title: Plan Daily Content Angles
use_cases.description: Find timely public topics and convert them into article, video, or social post ideas.

use_cases.title: Track Social Topic Momentum
use_cases.description: Review current hot list items and spot themes that may deserve audience testing.

use_cases.title: Build Editorial Trend Briefs
use_cases.description: Generate a short trend report that supports editorial planning and topic prioritization.

prompt_templates.title: Get Today Trends
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch the current TopHub hot list and summarize the strongest content themes for today.

prompt_templates.title: Create Topic Angles
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the TopHub trend analysis and suggest five topic angles for a short video audience.

prompt_templates.title: Filter For Niche
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze TopHub trends, then keep only ideas that fit my niche: {{niche}}. Explain why each idea fits.

prompt_templates.title: Build Editorial Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the skill, review the saved report, and create an editorial plan with title, angle, risk, and priority.

output_examples.input: Analyze today TopHub hot list for content ideas.
output_examples.output: A Markdown trend brief with high-potential topics, five content angles, and short traffic explanations.

output_examples.input: Find TopHub topics that fit a technology newsletter.
output_examples.output: A filtered set of technology-related trends with suggested headlines and relevance notes.

output_examples.input: Test the workflow without using the Anthropic API.
output_examples.output: A sample analysis report that confirms the output flow without calling Claude.

best_practices: Review fetched topics before relying on generated recommendations.
Keep API keys in a trusted local environment and avoid sharing logs.
Check saved reports for outdated links and factual claims before publishing.
anti_patterns: Do not run the script with untrusted environment values or unknown API base URLs.
Do not publish generated trend advice without source and accuracy checks.
Do not assume TopHub page structure or rankings are stable.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It fetches TopHub hot list items and asks Claude to suggest content angles.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. It fetches TopHub data and calls Anthropic unless mock mode is enabled.

faq.question: Does it use API keys?
faq.answer: Yes. It expects an Anthropic API key for normal analysis.

faq.question: Where are results saved?
faq.answer: It saves raw trend data and a Markdown analysis report in the trends output folder.

faq.question: Can it run without Claude?
faq.answer: Yes. Mock mode returns a sample report for workflow testing.

faq.question: Is the output ready to publish?
faq.answer: No. Treat it as planning support and verify facts before publishing.
